metadata.title: The DICTO Yantra: Lean 4 formalization (PALOMAR-2026-11-17-000006)
metadata.description:
Lean 4 formalization accompanying DICTO's paper #103, The DICTO Yantra (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24052633). It proves: Kulaichev's uniqueness question for the Śrī Yantra (1984): under the classical conditions in Huet's form as given by Chiodo, Kulaichev's four conditions and the admissibility of paper #103, exactly one figure exists, and its slope w7/b7 lies in a proved interval of width 2⁻²¹; the proof uses a kernel-checked certificate of 64,613 rational boxes.

Built with Lean 4 (leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc2) with Mathlib at commit 0653561 (tag v4.35.0-rc2). This archive is the GitHub repository DICTOR-Master/kulaichev-yantra-lean at commit 6bf9e0401c673ccf1030794493650331b7962b25, registered in the Palomar registry as PALOMAR-2026-11-17-000006-v2 at this commit; every proof is checked by the Lean kernel.
